rationale: Before mitigation 8 of 10 values lie within the normal band [0.90, 1.10] pu (80%), below the required 95%, so the case is non-compliant; t03=0.889 and t04=0.895 are below 0.90 pu and no value exceeds 1.10 pu. Applying the +0.025 pu additive tap correction shifts every value up so all 10 fall inside [0.90, 1.10] pu (max 1.091 pu, min 0.914 pu) with no absolute-limit violation (absolute band [0.85, 1.10] pu). The +0.05 pu option would push t09 to 1.116 pu, violating the absolute upper limit, and non-positive taps leave the under-voltage samples below the normal band.
